query:
SELECT medium AS "medium!", id AS "id!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT medium, id,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY medium ORDER BY id) AS rn
                    FROM track
                    WHERE medium = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR id > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY medium, id
